title: The weekly review's command shapes and records (v1)
description: The output of brain weekly plan, the judged input of brain weekly select and its output, the input of brain weekly record, the run state _weekly/state.json and the attempt marker _weekly/attempt.json. Behaviour is normative in spec/weekly-review.md; the commands are spec/cli.md §5.34 (decisions 0075, 0093). Every timestamp is UTC with seconds and Z (cli.md §3.1); every date is YYYY-MM-DD.

taskUrl.description: A Notion task's page URL: https://www.notion.so/ and the page id without dashes.

counts.description: One week's counts (weekly-review.md §5, §9.5). From 0.17.0: A Actions (at most 5), C doubtful items (at most 10), the cleaned items, T targets of new session items (at most 5) and queued. A week written before 0.17.0 has decisions and new_items in place of actions, doubtful and cleaned, and stays valid.

claimKey.description: A corrected claim (weekly-review.md §8.1): <target>:<field> for a fact, <decision id> for a supersede, <target>:rule:<proposal id> for a rule.

fingerprint.description: A reflection finding or a clean-up item (schema §11.4); the same pattern as proposal.schema.json $defs/fingerprint.

findingKey.description: An Ultimate Assistant finding (assistant.md §3.3); the same pattern as assistant.schema.json $defs/findingKey.

itemKey.description: A weekly finding key (weekly-review.md §7): an assistant key, a reflection or clean-up fingerprint, correction:<claim key>, or proposal:<id> for a carried item whose proposal has no key (§15.6).

clusterKey.description: A reflection cluster (cli.md §5.32): <signal>:<member ids sorted, joined by +>, or recurring_term:<slug>.

category.description: What kind of attention a finding asks for: the assistant's categories (assistant.md §3.3) and the knowledge ones. overdue is the category §7 rule 2 compares. cleanup is a mechanical item (weekly-review.md §15.2).

repetition.description: Whether a finding may be a decision item this week (weekly-review.md §7). show is false for a finding shown before whose evidence, overdue state and urgency are unchanged and that is no critical problem. because: new (never shown, or shown 26 weeks ago and dropped), this_week (already an item of this week: a rerun keeps it), evidence, overdue, urgency, critical (§7 rules 1 to 4), or null when show is false. pending is the finding's pending proposal, when it has one. carried: an item of an earlier row never set Ready (§15.6).

shown.description: The last week it was a decision item, or null.

change.description: A What changed candidate (weekly-review.md §4.2). key is <kind>:<ref> (changed:<note>:<field>:<learned> for a fact). ref is a note id, or notion:<page id> for a task. path is the note's file (null for a task), url the task's page (null for a note). bullet marks the 8 a report shows (§4.3: by weight, then newest, then key); the rest are covered by count.

field.description: changed only: the fact's field; before and after are its earlier and new accepted values.

draft.description: true when the note is a draft: the bullet ends *(not reviewed)* (weekly-review.md §3).

subject.description: A subject of Task analysis (weekly-review.md §3.3): the finding's key, its title, its task page URL (null for a project or an Area, or brain only) and the evidence text the assistant would write (assistant.md §4.1).

finding.description: An assistant finding as brain assistant findings gives it (cli.md §5.31, every finding, no page cap), with its repetition.

cluster.description: A reflection cluster as brain reflect --candidates gives it (cli.md §5.32), in the window (weekly-review.md §4.1), with carried true when an earlier partial run left it (§10). Its other keys (shared, evidence, held, names, term, fingerprint) pass through reflection's shape on purpose: §5.32 owns them, and plan adds only carried.

factValue.description: An old or new value of a claim: a fact value, a title or a rule's text.

correctionTarget.description: A candidate target of a claim (weekly-review.md §8.2): one per note, its fact equal to an old value (field set, line null) or the one body line holding it. line_after is the line with the old value replaced by the new one, null when no such one-for-one replacement exists (then the target can't be judged restatement). before_hash is the note's body hash for a line, null for a fact. pending is the waiting correction group that already holds a change to this note.

claim.description: A queued correction check (weekly-review.md §8.1) and its candidate targets (§8.2): note is the claim's note (the fact's or the title's, the superseded decision, the rule's target), title its title, old its old values (none for a rule), new its new value, date its newest meaning change, source, why and passages the meaning change's own. open is true when it comes from corrections.open (queued targets, §7 rule 4). Only claims with at least one target are listed.

plan.description: The full plan of brain weekly plan (cli.md §5.34): the hand-off file <label>.plan.json it saves next to the snapshot, which the skill reads in parts; its data is planSummary. clusters holds at most settings.weekly.max_judged clusters, carried ones first (weekly-review.md §10), then the window's in reflection's rank; clusters_left names the window's clusters beyond that limit, which a run omits (§10) and carries. findings excludes the dismissed (assistant.md §3.5) and keeps every other one, with its repetition. pending lists the pending proposals whose finding, fingerprint or correction is a candidate's key. week_state is this week's from _weekly/state.json (zeros and no items for a new week). earlier_open counts the earlier findings not shown again whose proposal is pending (§7). quiet is weekly-review.md §9.1, a same-week rerun with an unchanged input_hash included; it is false whenever notion is unreachable (a failure). From 0.17.0 (weekly-review.md §15): source is the run's agent session, the source of the proposals select words; cleanup the mechanical items of brain cleanup plan (cli.md §5.38) and cleanup_auto settings.cleanup.auto; done the snapshot's tasks and projects finished in the window (§3.2), newest first; carry the pending Actions and doubtful items of earlier rows whose Brain Status in the snapshot's weekly_rows is New, or that were never published, in their rows' order (§15.6). pending's weekly is the week of the row that offers the proposal, or null.

local_date.description: The run's local date (the machine's time zone): the week's day.

window.description: weekly-review.md §4.1. first: no earlier week's success, so from is as_of minus 7 days. days: whole days from from to to.

report.description: This week's report when one exists (a rerun updates it, weekly-review.md §2), else null.

changes.description: Every change in the window, by weight, then date (newest first), then key.

inputs.description: The meetings and sources (not minutes) dated in the window: header line 2's counts (weekly-review.md §3.1, §4.2).

skipped_signals.description: As brain assistant findings gives it.

task_analysis.description: The CLI's candidates for Task analysis (weekly-review.md §3.3): up to 3 subjects per category, and up to 3 for the order of attention, in the assistant's rank. Every open problem is listed here, shown before or not.

judgedFinding.description: A finding the skill drew from a cluster it judged (cli.md §6.2 step 2): its kind, fingerprint (schema §11.4), targets (one note, or the duplicate and the survivor of a merge), the cluster's evidence ids, and the words of its decision item. critical is not the skill's to say: select computes it (a contradiction on a reviewed note, §7 rule 4).

correctionJudgment.description: The skill's verdict on one candidate target of a claim (weekly-review.md §8.2). CC-254.

planSummary.description: The data of brain weekly plan (cli.md §5.34): what the skill needs to go on without reading the plan file (a large brain's plan is far above Claude Code's 30k Bash output limit, which a scheduled run's allow list can't read back). file is the absolute path of the saved plan, null when quiet (a quiet plan writes nothing). counts are the lengths of the plan's lists; findings_shown counts the findings whose repetition.show is true.

selectInput.description: The input of brain weekly select (cli.md §5.34): the plan, by its input_hash (select reads the saved plan file, the scheduled run's way) or embedded as it came (tests, attended use), and what the skill judged. judged.clusters lists every cluster the skill judged, a finding drawn or not; a cluster of plan.clusters not listed there, and every key of plan.clusters_left, is omitted (weekly-review.md §10). Each finding's cluster must be a judged cluster of the plan (INPUT_INVALID).

input_hash.description: planSummary.input_hash: the saved plan file must have it (INPUT_INVALID otherwise: plan again).

next_steps.description: The next steps the skill wrote from a project's own notes and inputs (weekly-review.md §6.1), one per project_no_next_step finding of the plan it can word: the task's words and why (citing the notes). Only such a finding becomes an Action (a new_task); the others are Focus first only.

item.description: An item of the week (weekly-review.md §6.1), numbered n in select's order. part: A an Action, C a doubtful item (both in the row, decided by a tick), T a session item counted in Waiting for you (a correction group or a contradiction). write is true when step 8 must write its proposal (proposal null); false when it links an existing pending proposal. proposal_input, when present on a write item, is the exact proposals list of its brain proposal new input: a correction group's review_notes and changes (§8.4), a next step's new_task, a mechanical item's merge, archive_draft or fix_structure while settings.cleanup.auto is off; the skill writes the other items' proposals from recommendation (work stream) or finding (knowledge stream). carried_from names the week of the row it came from (§15.6). targets are the note ids it changes, or notion:<page id>.

shown_of.description: A correction group admitted in part: <k> of <size> shown (§5.2, §8.4).

proposal_input.description: the exact proposals list of its brain proposal new input: a correction group's review_notes and changes (§8.4), a next step's new_task, a mechanical item's merge, archive_draft or fix_structure while settings.cleanup.auto is off; the skill writes the other items' proposals from recommendation (work stream) or finding (knowledge stream).

selection.description: The data of brain weekly select (cli.md §5.34), also saved as the hand-off file <label>.selection.json next to the plan file: the plan's input_hash, the decision items in report order, the queued remainder, this week's counts after the items (the week's earlier counts included, §5.1), the earlier findings whose proposals still wait for a decision (§7), what the run omitted (§10) and its coverage. From 0.17.0 the items are the row's Actions (A, at most 5) and doubtful items (C, at most 10) and the session items (T, at most 5 targets); a carried item left out is queued with its proposal and the week it came from (§15.6).

input_hash.description: The input_hash of the plan it selected from.

corrections.description: What the run did with each claim of the plan (weekly-review.md §8.4): open lists the targets still queued (not admitted, or not judged), [] when the claim is finished; clarify counts its uncertain matches.

recordInput.description: The input of brain weekly record (cli.md §5.34): plan's and select's data, by the plan's input_hash (record reads the two saved hand-off files, the scheduled run's way) or both embedded as they came, the proposal written for each item whose write is true (step 8; a DUPLICATE_PENDING names the existing one), the skill's prose for Your week (weekly-review.md §3.2: in_short, highlights, focus_first), the mechanical items step 5a applied (cleaned: brain cleanup apply's data.applied as returned, [] when none or auto is off), the run's mode, whether the report will be published as the week's Inbox row (weekly-review.md §9.3: refused from an unattended run while settings.publish isn't auto), the failures of earlier steps, and the run's notes read and seconds for the log line. record renders the header (§3.1), Done this week, Actions, Waiting for you and Clean-up itself.

input_hash.description: planSummary.input_hash: the saved plan and selection files must both have it (INPUT_INVALID otherwise).

in_short.description: One or two sentences on the week, one line, citing nothing new.

highlights.description: At most 6 bullets, each one line starting - **<Label>:** with the labels in §3.2's order, linked and dated; or the one line - Nothing new this week.

focus_first.description: 1 to 3 numbered lines 1. <subject>: <reason>; or the one line - No overdue, stalled or blocked work.

items.pattern: ^[1-3]\. [^\n]+$|^- No overdue, stalled or blocked work\.$

state.description: _weekly/state.json (weekly-review.md §9.5), written only by brain weekly record. last_success: the latest report written; covered_to is its window.to, covered_on_to the change keys dated on covered_to's UTC date that it covered, so a change made later that day is still next week's (§4.1). weeks: the last 8 weeks, each with its report, window (window_from and window_skip, the keys a rerun keeps out on from's date), input_hash, counts and item keys. shown: entries of the last 26 weeks, one per key. queued: this week's queued remainder. carry: omitted cluster keys (§10). corrections: the correction cursor (§8.1).

corrections_from.description: corrections as they were before this week's first report (weekly-review.md §8.1, §9.5): a rerun reads the cursor from here.

row.description: 0.17.0 (weekly-review.md §9.5): each label of the week's row (A, C, U) → its proposal and base, the { path, hash } of each Git file its change would write, read when record wrote the row ([] for a Notion write, a new note or a cleaned item).

carried_to.description: The week its pending items moved to (§15.6), else null.

corrections.description: The correction cursor (weekly-review.md §8.1, §9.5): checked_on and the claims finished on that date, and the claims with targets still queued, each with what plan needs to list it again.

correctionsList.description: The data of brain weekly corrections list (cli.md §5.34).

correctionsDone.description: The input of brain weekly corrections done (cli.md §5.34): each claim the on-demand path went through, with the targets it left queued.

attempt.description: _weekly/attempt.json, gitignored (weekly-review.md §9.5): written by the skill at step 5, removed after step 10.

cleanupItem.description: A mechanical item (weekly-review.md §15.2): its kind, title (imperative) and why, its fingerprint, the notes it changes and the files it may write, and the exact brain proposal new input of it (a merge, an archive_draft or a fix_structure with its tidy, fingerprint, why and source).

cleanupPlan.description: The data of brain cleanup plan (cli.md §5.38): the mechanical items in weekly-review.md §15.2's order, and held, the items left out because their fingerprint was undone or declined before.

rowState.description: One Weekly row's to-dos as the skill read them through the MCP (cli.md §5.34 --row-state, §5.38 ticks): each label, whether it is ticked, and the text after Your note:, trimmed ("" when empty).

ticksInput.description: The input of brain cleanup ticks (cli.md §5.38): a Ready Weekly row as the skill read it, its week, its page and when it was read (the decisions' decided_at).

ticksResult.description: The data of brain cleanup ticks (cli.md §5.38): what happened to each item, the Notion writes for the skill to make through the MCP and settle, and whether nothing in the row waits any more.
